item.title: Documentary ‘Had Anhad’ Reclaims Kabir’s Notion Of Ram From The Ruins Of The Babri Masjid
item.description: Documentary ‘Had Anhad’ Reclaims Kabir’s Notion Of Ram From The Ruins Of The Babri Masjid 'Had Anhad' searches for Kabir's Ram — a formless, boundless presence — as a counterpoint that defies the politicised Ram born after the Babri Masjid demolition.

item.title: When The Sky Falls: When & How To Watch The Geminids Meteor Shower In India This December
item.description: How to Watch the Geminids: December’s Most Spectacular Meteor Shower The Geminid meteor shower is back and at its peak on December 13–14. With low moon interference until 3 AM, this is one of the best chances to catch 50–60 shooting stars an hour.

item.title: Joy As An Act Of Resistance: Manjeet Sarkar On Power, Privilege, & "Internet Gangsters"
item.description: Joy As An Act Of Resistance: Manjeet Sarkar On Power, Privilege, & 'Internet Gangsters' Watching Manjeet bloom over the years as a creative has been a real treat. Especially amidst the anxieties around creative work today, where everything has to justify itself in numbers — views, reach, ticket sales, and marketability.

item.description: 'Amputate The Fake': Shilpa Ananth’s Tamil-Soul & RnB Track Is A Call To Awaken The Real Deep bass grooves, layered harmonies, and Tona’s soulful flugelhorn riffs anchor a soundscape that moves between soul, R&B, jazz, and hip-hop.
